en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a Scandinavian fishing harbor lined with wooden houses and boathouses, many with pitched roofs and small docks. Numerous fishing vessels and small boats are moored along both sides of the narrow inlet. In the foreground are moored sailboats and a wooden ramp or pier. Low rocky islands are visible in the background. The caption at the bottom left reads "Smögen. Hamnen." and there is a small triangular publisher's logo with the number 284 at the bottom right.
